caption: How much the lagged SOX/SPY relative strength signal adds OVER SPY's own 63-day momentum, in a HAC local-projection regression. Green bars mark horizons where it adds significantly: at 21 days (p=0.033) it does; at 63 days (p=0.075) it does not. The incremental R² is about 1 percentage point at both horizons — a thin, horizon-dependent edge, not a robust one.
narrative_alignment_note: Directly visualizes honesty mandate #3: marginal, horizon-dependent edge over SPY-own-momentum; values from CSV.
